Our Story

Engineering a Brighter
Energy Future

Mumbai Based Operations
🎯
Mission
Simplify solar procurement. Reduce installer friction. Improve execution speed. Act as a trusted partner.
🔭

⚡
Why SolWay
Premium products, quick supply, competitive pricing, aftersales services – all under one trusted brand.
🤝
Long-term commitment
Long-term partnerships built on transparency, technical excellence, and relentless after-sales support.

India is undergoing one of the largest energy transitions in the world. As solar adoption accelerates across residential, commercial and industrial sectors, the need for a reliable, efficient and scalable supply chain has become increasingly critical.

SolWay was founded to help bridge that gap.

Built around operational reliability and long-term supply partnerships, SolWay exists to simplify and strengthen the solar procurement ecosystem. We believe that installers, EPC contractors and project developers should be able to focus on building energy infrastructure — not navigating fragmented supply chains, inconsistent availability and procurement uncertainty.

Based in Mumbai, SolWay is a solar solutions company delivering end-to-end EPC services alongside the distribution of high-quality solar equipment for residential, commercial and industrial projects. We provide reliable access to solar modules, inverters, mounting structures and balance-of-system components through a network of trusted manufacturing and supply partners.

Our approach combines engineering-led project execution with dependable procurement. We work closely with customers and project partners to improve system design, reduce supply risk and support delivery through disciplined project management, logistics, technical guidance and responsive service.

At its core, SolWay was built with a larger purpose: to help organize and modernize India's solar supply chain and support the nation's transition toward renewable energy. As India advances its ambition to become a global leader in clean energy, we aim to be a trusted partner enabling the deployment of solar infrastructure across the country.

The future of energy is renewable. Our role is to help build the supply network that makes that future possible.

Leadership Team

The people behind SolWay

Founder & CEO
Manav Shah
Founder & CEO

Manav founded SolWay with the vision of building a more organized, reliable, and scalable solar supply chain for India. He believes that accelerating the country's transition to renewable energy requires not only world-class manufacturing and technology, but also efficient distribution networks, strong operational execution, and greater technical support across the industry.

Prior to founding SolWay, Manav worked as an Investment Banking Analyst at Moelis & Company in London, where he advised on mergers and acquisitions across the European energy and infrastructure sectors. During this time, he worked closely with solar, wind, grid, and broader clean energy businesses, gaining first-hand exposure to the challenges and opportunities shaping the global energy transition.

Through his experience in the energy sector and ongoing collaboration with manufacturers, installers, EPC contractors, and project developers, Manav developed a deep understanding of the operational challenges facing the solar industry. He established SolWay to improve procurement efficiency, strengthen supply reliability, and help raise technical standards across the installation ecosystem through knowledge sharing, training, and long-term industry partnerships.

His mission is to help build the infrastructure and supply networks that will enable renewable energy adoption at scale and support India's emergence as a global leader in clean energy.
